name: Single-Pass Splat Rendering Pipeline
definition: A rendering pipeline that operates in one single rendering pass, using VBOs for elevation data and texture objects for attributes, avoiding multiple render targets or additional blending passes.
summary: Single-Pass Splat Rendering Pipeline is a real-time splat rendering method that achieves high-quality shading effects in one pass by using object-space attribute interpolation on regular grid patches instead of screen-space blending.
